scope: Exact conditional block-elimination theorem applied numerically to four qualified finite harmonic models; not nonlinear atomistic dynamics, physical bath or native UD correspondence.
normalization: D=H_symmetric/h_star with h_star=lambda_max(H). All derivatives use mathematical dimensionless tau; no UD-native or laboratory clock is identified. Equal common mass is absorbed into tau. Unit-amplitude linear probes have no nonlinear validity claim.
partition: Coordinates ordered lateral x,y (52 or100) then vertical z (27 or51). D=[[A,C],[C.T,V]]. S=V-C.T A^-1 C, K(t)=C.T A^-1 cos(sqrt(A)t) C.
equation: zddot+S z+integral_0^t K(t-s) zdot(s) ds = -C.T cos(sqrt(A)t)(ell0+A^-1 C z0)-C.T A^-1/2 sin(sqrt(A)t) elldot0.
initial_preparations: vertical_unrelaxed: z0=normalized sin(sqrt(2)*index), other coordinates/velocities zero
conditional_lateral_equilibrium: same z0, ell0=-A^-1 C z0, all velocities zero
hidden_displacement: ell0=normalized sin(sqrt(2)*index), all other state components zero
hidden_velocity: elldot0=normalized cos(sqrt(3)*index), all other state components zero

reduced_integrator.realization: r_j=int cos(omega_j(t-s)) (G zdot(s))_j ds, s_j=int sin(omega_j(t-s)) (G zdot(s))_j ds. rdot=G zdot-omega*s, sdot=omega*r; both start zero. No full trajectory supplied to this solve.

full_reference: Independent full-D eigendecomposition, exact cosine/sine propagator; full block inverse for transfer checks.

direct_quadrature.purpose: Direct history integral along full-reference velocity, independent of memory auxiliary ODE

positive_type_test: Eight times uniformly0..80 and deterministic vector sin((i+1)*(j+1)*sqrt(2)), normalized jointly; compare kernel double sum with spectral sum of squared complex amplitudes. K(t) itself need not be PSD.
ablation: Independently solve the same reduced equation with all initial-source terms deleted. Require visible vertical error>1e-6 in unrelaxed/hidden-displacement/hidden-velocity preparations; conditional-equilibrium preparation must still match the full trajectory. No refitting.
